visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men in casual clothing, including one in an orange beanie and patterned sweater, perform a synchronized dance move outdoors. They stand in front of a blue backdrop with posters and large, colorful inflatable blue and red figures. The setting is bright with natural daylight, showing a concrete wall background. (2) A man in an orange beanie speaks excitedly to the camera in a dim, indoor space with warm yellow lighting. He gestures with his hands held together and then spreads them wide, showing a shocked facial expression. Behind him, dark curtains and soft lighting fixtures are visible. (3) A high-angle shot shows several people gathered around a large board game mat on the floor titled "This is a Monopoly". They use their hands to move small plastic horse figures across the colorful squares. The indoor lighting is bright and overhead. (4) A red LED scrolling sign above an open doorway displays text in a darkened room. The camera pans slightly to show a balcony area beyond the door under overcast outdoor light, with white curtains framing the doorway inside. (5) A man in a black hoodie and cap sits on a large, brown plush mechanical horse toy on a tiled balcony. He smiles and bounces slightly as the toy moves. The background shows a residential urban alleyway under cloudy skies. (6) Three men look at a wall covered in many white and yellow sticky notes. They whisper and point at the notes while smiling. The setting is a narrow indoor corridor with a wooden ceiling and soft ambient light. (7) Three men lie side-by-side on a large white bed in a dimly lit hotel room with a glowing orange lamp. They wake up simultaneously, stretch their arms upward, and look toward a CRT television screen on the left. (8) A woman in a yellow jacket enters a room and gives a warm hug to the man in the orange beanie. He smiles broadly and wraps his arms around her. The background shows a dimly lit bedroom with soft blue light emanating from a bed frame. (9) Two men discuss something in a bright bathroom area. One man in a black hoodie demonstrates a posture by placing one foot on a toilet, while the other man in an orange beanie watches with a surprised face. (10) A group of people dances energetically in a room filled with numerous old CRT monitors displaying abstract green images. The lighting is low and atmospheric with neon-like glows. (11) A group of people reflects themselves in a large, red-rimmed circular mirror on a street. They crouch down to fit in the frame, pointing at their reflections and smiling under flat outdoor lighting.
